_comment: Pulp pressed with deretheni. The pulper did the work a recipe cannot: stripping, cooking and beating
the wood, and the water a sheet is laid from, which is why there is no bucket here any more.
Deretheni is the danger material, which design 7.1.1 asks both mid-tier rungs to carry so that it stays
load-bearing rather than a midgame reward the endgame walks past. It is whole here and ground in the
ink, so each ladder spends it the way its own station leaves it.
One pulp to a sheet. Shapeless, because this is a vat and an arrangement would imply otherwise.
